pool-sync      BenchmarkSyncPoolGetPut-16   15821949  7.237 ns/op  0 B/op  0 allocs/op

The timed sync.Pool loop Puts the value back, so the steady state reports 0 allocs/op.
TestSyncPoolAllocatesFromNew covers an empty pool: Get calls New and allocates.
The default OrderBook path is the array free list. sync.Pool is not linked into the matcher.
